## 2024-03-23 - Hardcoded JWT Secret Vulnerability

**Vulnerability:** A static, globally accessible hardcoded JWT secret (`var jwtKey = []byte("your_secret_key")`) was present in `internal/auth/auth.go` and `cmd/api/main.go`, meaning all tokens generated by the application could be predicted, forged, or intercepted by any individual with access to the source code.

**Learning:** This exposes the application to authentication bypass and authorization circumvention, completely compromising the integrity of the JWT authentication system. Furthermore, secrets should never be embedded in the source code as it makes key rotation impossible without deploying a new version of the app.

**Prevention:** Always externalize application secrets. Using environment variables (e.g., `os.Getenv("JWT_SECRET")`) allows the secret to be securely injected at runtime from the deployment environment without exposing it in the codebase. Always write tests that enforce secret presence before attempting generation or validation.
